finalText:
Fixed. `resolveRelease` in `packages/shared/config.js` merged layers with `Object.assign`, which replaces whole nested objects — so any package overriding one key inside `output` or `sourcemap` (like `@acme/api`) silently dropped its siblings, and `build.js` aborted at the bundle stage with `EBUNDLE07 config-incomplete`.

Replaced it with a proper deep merge so partial overrides only touch the key they name. `build.js` and `verify.js` both pass now, exit 0.
